slate_map3d.title: World map
slate_map3d.settings.section.desc: The map of Xaero's World Map or JourneyMap, and Xaero's Minimap, as a model of the land you have explored.
slate_map3d.settings.enabled.tip: Shows the map mod's map as a model of the land: every column at its height, to turn, tilt and fly over. Off, the map is the mod's own and nothing of this shows anywhere.
slate_map3d.settings.key.tip: Which map the map mod's own key opens while 3D maps are on. A button on each map leads to the other.
slate_map3d.settings.inventory.tip: A button in the row above the inventory that opens your map mod's map (the 3D one first, where that is set).
slate_map3d.settings.minimap.tip: Shows the land inside Xaero's Minimap as the 3D model, at a tilt, turning and zooming as the minimap does, with your waypoints and places as pins. Its frame, compass and lines stay the mod's. Underground, and where the land is not mapped, the minimap stays flat. Only while 3D maps are on.
slate_map3d.settings.unknown.title: No 3D map for this version
slate_map3d.settings.unknown.body: Slate does not know this version of the map mod. Its map stays as it is.
slate_map3d.view.3d.tip: The map as a model of the land
slate_map3d.view.2d.sample: This is a sample land: there is no flat map of it
slate_map3d.unavailable: The 3D map cannot open right now
slate_map3d.dimension.tip: The dimensions this map has land of
slate_map3d.layer.places.tip: Homes, warps, the spawn, where you died
slate_map3d.layer.players.tip: You, and the players near you that the map mod's own map shows
slate_map3d.layer.claims.tip: Whose land is whose, with its edge and its holder's name
slate_map3d.eye.north.key: N. Drag to turn and tilt, Q and E turn, R and F tilt.
slate_map3d.eye.player.key: H or Home. A double click flies anywhere.
slate_map3d.eye.player.elsewhere: You are not in this dimension
slate_map3d.eye.zoom_in.key: + or the wheel, towards the pointer
slate_map3d.eye.zoom_out.key: - or the wheel. Right drag or W A S D slides the land.
slate_map3d.broken: The land cannot be drawn on this graphics driver. The 2D map still works.
slate_map3d.select.title: %s chunks selected
slate_map3d.waypoint.name: Waypoint %s, %s
slate_map3d.sample.title: Sample land
slate_map3d.sample.would.title: Sample land
